hooks.text: 把士兵、工程师或驯兽师骑到恐龙背上，每种人龙组合都有专属能力
hooks.excerpt: Assign human units (soldier, engineer, tamer) to one of your dinos and let them ride! Each human/dino combination has powerful and unique special abilities.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 让雌雄恐龙进入繁育站，后代可能突变，甚至鼓励跨种杂交
hooks.excerpt: Put a male/female pair of dinos in your breeding station and let nature do its thing! The offspring may surprise you. Cross breeding with genetic mutations is encouraged.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用食物、干扰甚至求偶引诱敌对恐龙，驯服后反过来加入己方
hooks.excerpt: Lure in enemy dinosaurs with food, distractions, or sex. Once tamed, they will fight alongside you.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 美术表现一般且略显模糊。

excerpts.excerpt: 游戏的美术这方面确实一般，甚至有点糊糊的。
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 复古RTS美学受到高度赞赏。

excerpts.excerpt: awesome retro RTS vibe and aesthetic
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: Another issue is the absence of quick formation tools.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: DNA局外天赋效果弱，缺乏真实成长感。

excerpts.excerpt: The perks you can buy with DNA don't do much, and don't feel as if you're getting real progression
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 地图解锁要求反复挑战同一地图。

excerpts.excerpt: creating a grind system where you have to replay the same maps on higher difficulties
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 自有建筑无法驻军限制了战术选择。

excerpts.excerpt: there’s no option to garrison your units inside watch towers or most of the buildings you construct.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: Executed well with hectic battles & surprisingly good resource management.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: still manages to deliver a serious challenge
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 多种系统并未让玩法过度复杂，仍易于上手。

excerpts.excerpt: Despite the variety, Repterra isn’t bogged down by complexity. It’s accessible
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
